positions.as_written: Measure thigh circumference or compare it visually, since quadriceps wasting is common and is the main modifiable finding.
Examine the menisci and the joint lines deliberately, because secondary injury is common and changes the plan.
Quadriceps deficit should be addressed before reconstruction rather than after, because a knee with better quadriceps function before surgery does better after it.
